data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 and SRC_005 are compatible with each other and jointly compatible with SRC_003's empiricist stance under the integration that all three treat the proportionality/covering principle as a real, defeasible assumption rather than an axiom. SRC_003 supplies the epistemic modality (expectation, not entailment), while SRC_001 and SRC_005 supply the pedagogical mechanism that renders the assumption invisible by construction. The integration is refuted if any one of the three instead treats linear pricing as a logical necessity from the problem text, or if their mechanisms are merely topically similar without a shared commitment to the defeasibility of the covering principle — a summary of the endpoints is not a relation.
